content.text: Access tokens are signed with `auth.secret`, but the JWT strategy verifies them with `auth.refreshSecret`.

candidates.explanation: The access-token strategy verifies the bearer token with 'auth.refreshSecret'. AuthService signs access tokens with 'auth.secret' (auth.service.ts ~line 619) and only refresh tokens with 'auth.refreshSecret'. Signature verification therefore fails for every fresh access token, and passport answers 401 on every protected endpoint. Login and refresh still work because they don't use this strategy.

fix.description: Use the access-token secret, 'auth.secret', in JwtStrategy instead of 'auth.refreshSecret'.
